SIGNALS OBSERVED: Random parents (0.9152–0.9297) and up to four random contexts; best 0.9297 frequently appeared as context. No labels: DIVERGE_LABEL 0, REFINE_LABEL 0; no child scores. Best stayed 0.9297 for 11 iterations.
